hero: a single rust-streaked fishing trawler standing upright on a cracked, bone-white clay seabed, tilted and half-sunk in the crust, with open desert in every direction and a shimmering empty horizon behind it
why_click: The title says a lake was erased; the image shows boats that were left behind on dry land with no water in sight, and the arrow points at the empty horizon where the sea should be — you have to click to learn how a trawler ends up kilometres inland.

shrink_test.about: Abandoned ships stranded in dried-up sea basins
